one_row_was_discarded_and_why: a twelfth row came back as the keyword "nagano" at 800 a month. The submitted keyword was "quando andare a Nagano, Nagano" and the comma inside the city name split the comma-separated list, so Ahrefs answered a different query. The row is not evidence for this family and the keyword builder now strips commas from city names.
